tours.name: Set Up a Recurring Deduction on Salary

name_i18n.en_US: Set Up a Recurring Deduction on Salary

tours.description: Learn how to record an amount that is taken from an employee's salary every month, such as a loan or advance repayment, using a salary attachment that payslips pick up automatically.

description_i18n.en_US: Learn how to record an amount that is taken from an employee's salary every month, such as a loan or advance repayment, using a salary attachment that payslips pick up automatically.

steps.title: Open Payroll
steps.description: Recurring amounts that affect an employee's pay are recorded in the Payroll app as salary attachments.

description_i18n.en_US: Recurring amounts that affect an employee's pay are recorded in the Payroll app as salary attachments.

steps.title: Contracts menu
steps.description: The Contracts menu holds the contracts and the salary attachments linked to each employee's pay.

description_i18n.en_US: The Contracts menu holds the contracts and the salary attachments linked to each employee's pay.

steps.title: Salary Attachments
steps.description: This list shows every recurring deduction, such as loan repayments, with its status and remaining amount.

description_i18n.en_US: This list shows every recurring deduction, such as loan repayments, with its status and remaining amount.

steps.title: New attachment
steps.content: Click New to create a salary attachment.

content_i18n.en_US: Click New to create a salary attachment.

steps.description: The New button opens a blank attachment where you describe the amount, who pays it and for how long.

description_i18n.en_US: The New button opens a blank attachment where you describe the amount, who pays it and for how long.

steps.title: Employee
steps.content: Click here to open the list of employees.

content_i18n.en_US: Click here to open the list of employees.

steps.description: An attachment can apply to one or several employees. Opening the field shows the employees you can choose from.

description_i18n.en_US: An attachment can apply to one or several employees. Opening the field shows the employees you can choose from.

steps.title: Choose the employee
steps.description: Pick the employee whose salary the amount will be taken from.

description_i18n.en_US: Pick the employee whose salary the amount will be taken from.

steps.title: Description
steps.content: Type a short description, then press Tab.

content_i18n.en_US: Type a short description, then press Tab.

steps.description: The description explains the reason for the deduction, such as Staff loan or Salary advance. It is shown to payroll officers who review the payslip.

description_i18n.en_US: The description explains the reason for the deduction, such as Staff loan or Salary advance. It is shown to payroll officers who review the payslip.

steps.title: Deduction type
steps.content: Click here to open the list of deduction types.

content_i18n.en_US: Click here to open the list of deduction types.

steps.description: The type decides how the amount appears on the payslip, for example as a loan repayment or an attachment of salary.

description_i18n.en_US: The type decides how the amount appears on the payslip, for example as a loan repayment or an attachment of salary.

steps.title: Choose the type
steps.description: Choose the type that matches the reason for the deduction.

description_i18n.en_US: Choose the type that matches the reason for the deduction.

steps.title: Monthly amount
steps.content: Type the amount to deduct each month, then press Tab.

content_i18n.en_US: Type the amount to deduct each month, then press Tab.

steps.description: This is the amount taken from each monthly payslip until the total is reached.

description_i18n.en_US: This is the amount taken from each monthly payslip until the total is reached.

steps.title: Total amount
steps.content: Type the total amount to recover, then press Tab.

content_i18n.en_US: Type the total amount to recover, then press Tab.

steps.description: Deductions stop automatically once the total amount has been recovered, and the attachment is marked as completed.

description_i18n.en_US: Deductions stop automatically once the total amount has been recovered, and the attachment is marked as completed.

steps.title: Save
steps.content: Click the save icon to keep the attachment.

content_i18n.en_US: Click the save icon to keep the attachment.

steps.description: Saving makes the attachment active. The next payslip computed for this employee includes the monthly deduction.

description_i18n.en_US: Saving makes the attachment active. The next payslip computed for this employee includes the monthly deduction.
